id./param/scenario/cs/b_110_cs_160.pack|cs_: "I happened to find it on today's voyage. ...It's your birthday today. A present, sort of.
"...Huh? What a shabby necklace. If you celebrate my birthday, try harder.
"Oh, I heard a rumor and want the Red Orb. A treasure of Heliodor.
"That necklace has a story. It brings gold, silver and treasure to the wearer one after another.
"Sounds fake, but fitting for a greedy one like you. So make do with it for now...
"Brother... this... I touched a copper coin to polish it, and...
"It was just a copper coin a moment ago... but when I touched it, it suddenly became gold!
"Amazing, amazing! I can turn anything to gold! This necklace is the best, brother!!"
